title: Govbase
description: U.S. federal policy data — bills, Congress members, voting records, and civic info.
summary: U.S. federal policy data — bills, Congress members, voting records, and civic info.
offersHint: U.S. federal policy data — bills, Congress members, voting records, and civic info. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.govbase.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_policies
toolsPreview.description: Search U.S. federal policies and legislation by keyword, topic, or bill name. Returns a list of matching policies with summaries.

toolsPreview.name: get_policy
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific U.S. federal policy by its ID (e.g., "bill-119-hr-22" or "eo-2025-1234").

toolsPreview.name: get_policy_text
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the full text of a U.S. federal policy document. Returns the raw legislative or regulatory text.

toolsPreview.name: search_members
toolsPreview.description: Search current U.S. members of Congress by name, state, party, or chamber. Returns a list of matching members with key details.

toolsPreview.name: get_member
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific U.S. member of Congress by their Bioguide ID (e.g., "P000197" for Nancy Pelosi).

toolsPreview.name: get_member_vote
toolsPreview.description: Check how a specific U.S. member of Congress voted on a policy by providing their Bioguide ID and the policy ID. Returns all roll call votes for that member on the given policy.

toolsPreview.name: get_stories
toolsPreview.description: List current story bundles tracking ongoing policy issues. Returns a feed of active stories grouping related policies and developments.

toolsPreview.name: get_story
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific story bundle by its ID, including the full timeline of related events.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_effort
toolsPreview.description: Answer "what is going on with policy X?" — resolve a bill nickname, acronym, or media name ("SAVE Act", "big beautiful bill") to the effort tracking that policy goal across every bill that has carried it, through reintroductions and new Congresses.

toolsPreview.name: get_effort
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve an effort by ID: the maintained plain-language answer to "what is happening with this?", the full bill lineage across Congresses, current status, next actor, and story coverage.

toolsPreview.name: get_representatives
toolsPreview.description: Look up elected representatives for a given U.S. address, including federal, state, and local officials.

toolsPreview.name: get_voter_info
toolsPreview.description: Get election and polling location information for a registered U.S. voter address, including upcoming elections and early vote sites.
